name: CHUM handoff and conversion attribution
purpose: Issue privacy-minimized referral tokens for public Evercraft handoffs and distinguish landing, checkout, verified payment, and fulfillment without treating checkout or caller-asserted provider identity as proof.

browser_handoff.note: Keep this richer signed-attribution corridor for a future public Forge runtime. Public CHUM Start links currently use the live Machine Commerce gateway so buyers never land on an undeployed relative API route.

stages.landing: A signed CHUM referral recorded a public landing receipt before a human review handoff when attribution is configured.
stages.checkout_started: A user entered an approved checkout path. This is not payment.
stages.payment_verified: Trusted server-side/payment-authority evidence verified a payment. Public callers cannot assert this stage.
stages.fulfilled: Trusted evidence records fulfillment after a verified payment.

privacy.intent_fingerprint: HMAC-SHA256 of normalized intent when supplied
privacy.provider_identity: caller_asserted unless a separate provider receipt exists

revenue_rule: Only payment_verified events accepted through the trusted ingest boundary may count toward verified revenue.
provider_rule: A provider claim in a referral is attribution metadata, not proof that the named AI provider discovered or recommended Evercraft.
human_gate: Sell-now discovery may expose a Start path, but discovery and attribution create no payment obligation. Checkout still requires the product's explicit human confirmation and paid state still requires authoritative provider verification.
